launcherOptions.firewallNoticeIntro: ExilesGameManager manages only the local Windows Firewall rules for this server instance.
launcherOptions.firewallNoticeRouterBody: For access from the internet, the Game Port and, when enabled, the Steam Query Port must also be forwarded or allowed in your router, cloud firewall, or dedicated-server provider panel.
launcherOptions.firewallNoticeRestBody: Do not expose the REST API port directly to the public internet when ExilesGameManager uses it locally. Restrict it to localhost or a trusted private network.

backupCenter.scope: Backups include the complete Pal/Saved folder, including configuration, world saves, logs, and crash data.

taskQueue.title: Task Queue
taskQueue.description: Monitor and control long-running operations. Tasks are serialized per server so backups, updates, restores, firewall changes, and mod operations cannot modify the same instance at the same time.
taskQueue.empty: No tasks match the current filters.
taskQueue.selectTask: Select a task to inspect progress and logs.

activityCenter.title: Activity Center

modWishlist.emptySteam: No Steam Workshop requests are waiting.

steamCmdAuth.title: Steam Workshop Access
steamCmdAuth.connected: Temporary SteamCMD session connected. Credentials are not stored.
steamCmdAuth.description: Anonymous downloads are tried first. Sign in temporarily only when Palworld blocks anonymous Workshop access.
steamCmdAuth.security: The password and Steam Guard code are used only in memory for this temporary session. They are never saved or written to EGM logs.
steamCmdAuth.guardRequired: Steam Guard verification is required to finish the temporary sign-in.
steamCmdAuth.guardDescription: Enter the current code from the Steam Mobile app or the email sent by Steam. The code is used only in memory and is never logged.
steamCmdAuth.consoleHint: Anonymous downloads are attempted first. Open the normal SteamCMD console only when Steam requires an authenticated account.
steamCmdAuth.securityHint: Credentials, Steam Guard codes, and commands stay inside the external SteamCMD window.
steamCmdAuth.superAdminHint: Download requested Workshop items here, then approve them from the Steam Workshop Wishlist.

cache.title: Downloaded Workshop Mods
cache.description: Mods downloaded through the external SteamCMD console appear here automatically. Install or update them for the currently selected server with one click.
cache.empty: No downloaded Palworld Workshop mods were detected.
cache.installedMessage: {{name}} was installed for the selected server.

workshop.title: Browse Steam Workshop
workshop.description: Search Palworld Workshop mods and add any of them to the server wishlist for the super admin to review.
workshop.steamCmdSuperAdminHint: Open SteamCMD Console is available in Super Admin below Nexus Mods Integration.

steamBrowser.title: Browse Steam Workshop
steamBrowser.description: Search Palworld Workshop mods and add any of them to the server wishlist for the super admin to review.
steamBrowser.banner: Browse public Steam Workshop information and add mods to the server wishlist. The super admin decides whether to install each request.
steamBrowser.search: Search all Steam Workshop mods by name...
steamBrowser.error: Failed to load Steam Workshop mods.

steamWishlist.title: Steam Workshop Wishlist
steamWishlist.description: Steam Workshop requests are managed separately from Nexus Mods. The super admin downloads approved items through SteamCMD and installs them for the selected server.
steamWishlist.empty: No Steam Workshop mods are waiting for approval.

nexusDownloaded.title: Downloaded Nexus Mods
nexusDownloaded.description: Approved Nexus Mods are detected from all supported Palworld locations: UE4SS Mods, PAK ~mods, LogicMods, Workshop PAKs and PalMod packages. Uninstall removes the exact files installed for the selected mod.
nexusDownloaded.empty: No downloaded Nexus Mods were detected for this server.
nexusDownloaded.uninstallDialogDescription: {{name}} will be removed from the selected server, including its installed files and downloaded archive.
nexusDownloaded.uninstalledMessage: {{name}} was removed from the selected server.

nexusWishlist.title: Nexus Mods Wishlist
nexusWishlist.description: Nexus Mods requests waiting for approval are listed here. Approved and installed mods appear separately under Downloaded Nexus Mods.
nexusWishlist.empty: No Nexus Mods are waiting for approval.

updates.confirmInstall: Install EGM {{version}} now? EGM will close automatically.
updates.updateReady: EGM {{version}} is ready to install from GitHub.
updates.upToDate: This installation is up to date.
updates.panelHint: EGM downloads the release installer from GitHub, verifies the published SHA-256 checksum, closes itself and starts the installer in update mode. Settings, OAuth data, servers and backups are preserved.
updates.automaticFlow: EGM downloads the verified installer, closes all EGM processes, updates the existing installation and starts EGM again automatically. Settings, OAuth data, servers and backups remain unchanged.
